exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press
instructions: Set the bench or floor position and plant both feet firmly.
Brace the torso and keep the wrists stacked over the elbows.
Press the weight away from the body without losing shoulder position.
Lower the weight under control through a comfortable range.
Repeat without bouncing or shifting the torso.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Set the bench to a flat position and plant both feet firmly.
Start with the dumbbells above the chest, palms facing each other, and a soft bend in the elbows.
Lower the weights out and slightly down in a controlled arc until the chest is gently stretched.
Squeeze the chest to bring the dumbbells back together without turning the movement into a press.
Keep the elbow angle steady and stop before the shoulders feel strained.
formCues: Keep the shoulder blades set against the bench.
Keep a soft, consistent bend in the elbows.
